entries.answer:
- **Input Tokenization** → **Token Embeddings** + **Positional Encodings** (sinusoidal or learned)
- **Encoder Stack** (N identical layers):
  - **Multi-Head Self-Attention** (Q, K, V projections, scaled dot-product attention, concatenated heads)
  - **Add & LayerNorm** (residual connection + Layer Normalization)
  - **Position-wise Feed-Forward Network** (2 linear layers with ReLU/GELU activation)
  - **Add & LayerNorm** (residual connection + Layer Normalization)
- **Decoder Stack** (N identical layers):
  - **Masked Multi-Head Self-Attention** (causal masking for autoregressive generation)
  - **Cross-Attention** (queries from decoder, keys/values from encoder output)
  - **Add & LayerNorm** (after each attention sub-layer)
  - **Position-wise Feed-Forward Network** (same structure as encoder)
  - **Add & LayerNorm** (after FFN)
- **Output Projection** → **Linear Layer** (vocabulary size) → **Softmax** (probability distribution over tokens)

**Architectural Variants:**
- **Encoder-only** (BERT, RoBERTa) — bidirectional understanding, classification/NER/QA
- **Decoder-only** (GPT, LLaMA) — autoregressive generation, causal attention only
- **Encoder-Decoder** (T5, BART) — sequence-to-sequence tasks (translation, summarization)
